# Getting Help

Start with the [guides](https://github.com/clearstackio/forme-ruby/blob/main/docs/README.md)
and search existing issues. For an installation or rendering bug, open a bug
report with Ruby/OS/gem versions, installation commands, a minimal synthetic
example and sanitized diagnostics. Do not post customer documents or secrets.

Use the feature-request form for proposed improvements. This is an independent
community project; support response times are not guaranteed. Report potential
vulnerabilities privately using
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/clearstackio/forme-ruby/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
